summary: Frontend-only E2E of AppleBase's four new enhancements plus regressions. ALL 4 new features WORK. (1) COLOURWAY PICKER on /product/iphone-titan-pro-max: 'colorway-picker' renders 4 swatches; clicking 'colorway-crimson' flips 'selected-colorway' text 'Natural Titanium' -> 'Crimson' and the 'Finish - X' heading; clicking 'colorway-desert-sand' -> 'Desert Sand'; viewer canvas stays alive, 0 console errors, no model refetch. (2) COMPARE TRAY: 'compare-toggle-iphone-titan-pro-max' adds to tray (visible); 'compare-open-button' is disabled with 1 item and enabled with 2; opening shows 'compare-modal' with all spec cells ('compare-cell-price-*', 'compare-cell-condition-*', 'compare-cell-rating-*'); 'compare-close-button' closes; 'compare-remove-*' removes one; 'compare-clear-button' empties. (3) COMPARE LIMIT & PERSISTENCE: adding a 4th product keeps only 3 in localStorage key 'applebase-compare'; after full page reload, 2 remaining items are restored and tray is visible. (4) PRODUCT-PAGE COMPARE TOGGLE: 'product-compare-toggle' label flips 'Compare' <-> 'In compare'. (5) RECENTLY VIEWED: after visiting /product/watch-titan-ultra then /product/ipad-titan-pro-13, 'recently-viewed-section' + 'recently-viewed-rail' show the watch and never the current ipad; localStorage key 'applebase-recently-viewed'=['ipad-titan-pro-13','watch-titan-ultra']. On landing->showcase, 'showcase-recently-viewed' + 'rail-recently-viewed' appear. (6) SCENE CAPTIONS: 'scene-caption' visible at 1920px; content changes with scroll - scene-caption-hero at #hero, scene-caption-features at #features, scene-caption-showcase at #showcase, scene-caption-specs at #specs; 'scene-caption-link-specs' navigates to /product/watch-titan-ultra; caption is NOT visible at 390px (lg:block gating works). REGRESSIONS: cart-count-badge increments on grid add (0->1); hot filter returns 15 cards; search 'zzzzz' shows no-results-message; theme-toggle flips to dark. 5 GLB models load with no failed requests, 0 console errors (only benign THREE.GLTFLoader UV-set warnings and WebGL ReadPixels perf warnings, both carried over from prior iterations).

integration_issues.issue: Still not fully fixed. URL changes to '/' but window.scrollY stays 0 after ~3s wait. Iteration 2 reported this and main-agent claimed to pass target via router state + scroll once Landing mounts; the scroll trigger is still not firing after cross-route navigation. Works correctly from landing.

issues: The 3D watch model (fixed/scroll-pinned canvas) extends down into and visually overlaps the footer region, partially covering the right-column footer links at ~scrollY near bottom. Non-blocking (links are still clickable via left columns) but it covers the Support column links visually, which the problem statement specifically flagged as something to avoid.
At the very bottom of the page, 'scene-caption' (fixed bottom-right) overlaps the footer's right-most support column; may want to hide the caption once #cta/footer is in view.
Carried-over THREE.GLTFLoader warnings 'Custom UV set 1' for all GLBs - cosmetic only.

action_items: Fix nav from /product/:id to #specs/#features/#store: the route-state scrollTo scheme is still not working - window.scrollY remains 0. Likely race between Lenis re-init on Landing mount vs the scroll call. Consider: in Landing mount, wait for window.__lenis to be ready (next animation frame OR a short setTimeout) THEN call lenis.scrollTo(target). Alternatively, use native scrollIntoView on the section element after a 100-200ms RAF.

Hide SceneCaption (or clip the 3D watch canvas) once the footer enters the viewport so the watch model and caption chip don't cover the right-side footer links. E.g. IntersectionObserver on <footer> that toggles opacity on the caption + the pinned 3D canvas.
critical_code_review_comments: SceneCaption.tsx uses viewport-centre detection (middle = 45% of innerHeight). For sections shorter than ~500px this means a section can be skipped if scroll overshoots - defensive but observed working for all 4 acts. Consider adding a fallback 'last match wins' when no section matches to avoid dead-caption state (currently keeps previous active, which is fine).

useCompare.tsx: toggle correctly caps at MAX=3 with a toast and persists via localStorage - LGTM. Minor: setItems inside toggle calls toast as a side-effect during the state-updater function; works in React 18 but strict mode could call the updater twice and double-fire the toast. Prefer computing inside toggle before setItems, or guard with a ref.
useRecentlyViewed.ts: filters out currentId both at write (via spread) and at read (items filter) - correct and newest-first.
CompareTray.tsx compare-cell data-testid is lowercase label - matches the test contract.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of 4 new enhancements (colourway picker, compare tray incl. limit/persistence/product-page toggle, recently viewed on product + storefront, scene captions incl. mobile hide); 100% of core regressions (cart, filters, search, theme); 1 persistent integration issue carried over from iteration 2 (nav-link-* from product page does not scroll).

seed_data_creation: None (static catalogue; test manipulates localStorage keys applebase-compare and applebase-recently-viewed)
context_for_next_testing_agent: All four new enhancements are implemented correctly and pass. Only outstanding issue is the long-standing nav-from-product-page bug. For SceneCaption testing, use `window.__lenis.scrollTo(y, {duration: 0.1})` (NOT immediate:true) so scroll events fire naturally for the component's rAF-driven pick(). Caption-link testids follow 'scene-caption-link-<id>' only when the active caption has a `to` field (hero/features/specs); showcase has no link. Compare testids: cell is 'compare-cell-<lowercase-label>-<id>' (e.g. compare-cell-price-...). Clear localStorage between recently-viewed and compare tests to isolate state.
